voice.name: Test Voice
voice.basis: the channel's established narrator (same id as Myostatin, Zombie Ant and Zombie Snail); confirmed with creative_list_voices on 2026-11-01

prompt: [excited, urgent] If you try to eat this lizard, it can SHOOT BLOOD straight out of its eyes! [brisk, explaining] When a predator attacks, pressure builds inside tiny blood vessels behind its eyes. [building, intense] Until they BURST, launching a stream of blood right into the predator's mouth! [amused, grossed out] And the blood tastes so DISGUSTING to some predators that they spit the lizard out! [knowing, quick] Leaving it alive to do the exact same thing again.
prompt_note: The locked words, verbatim (production/NARRATION_LOCKED.txt). Capitals mark the brief's emphasis words (SHOOT BLOOD, BURST, disgusting); the bracket tags direct delivery and are not spoken.
generated_once: One run of two variations (the connector default), 2 x 469.95 credits. No regeneration.

takes.asr: whisper base.en WER 0.000; zipformer only misspells predator/predators
takes.note: 'disgusting' is stressed by length (0.71 s, the longest word in the take) rather than level

takes.why_not: weaker hook: 'SHOOT' +1.2 dB over the median word against +2.5 dB in take 1; otherwise equivalent

edits: One gap edit: the 0.50 s breath after the hook line shortened to 0.38 s (0.12 s removed, cut in the middle of the silent run with a 12 ms equal-power crossfade). Every word is used sample for sample: no time-stretch, pitch or gain change. See tools/make_narration.py.
word_timing: local sherpa-onnx Zipformer token timestamps snapped to measured pause onsets, re-measured on the edited master (tools/align_zipformer.py -> audio/narration/master_zipformer.json -> source/src/data/timeline.json)
listening: Not listened to in real time: this environment has no audio playback. Selection by two ASR models, pause and level measurement.
